title: Peer-release freshness, failure-domain separation, and optional-oracle readiness
mode: Primary-source issue/release review plus local plan crosswalk; research-only
scope: Refresh ezdxf binary proxy-graphic issue/fix/release artifact state.
Reconcile current ACadSharp and LibreDWG issue shapes with existing local owners.
Separate peer parser, writer, object-model, and consumer/native failure domains.
Refine the one-time optional peer checkpoint without adding routine dependencies or validation cost.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project issue pages, release metadata, and existing local plan/code references
method.limitations: The PyPI 1.4.5 release postdates ezdxf PR #1418, but the reviewed metadata does not bind the published artifact to that exact source commit. ACadSharp #1278 was visible only by issue title in this pass; #1283 details were available from an earlier primary-source review recorded in the plan. Issue-board status is not release behavior or a local reproduction.

sources.revision: Issue/PR status reviewed 2026-10-19; PyPI lists 1.4.5 uploaded 2026-10-16
sources.observed: Issue #1412 is closed via merged #1418 (Oct 2), which routes raw proxy bytes through the tag-writer protocol. PyPI lists 1.4.5 after that merge; its py3-none-any wheel SHA-256 is 70a79ec7d40990f60453e3c87ffe9f668907ee061cf6f4c0a3794d032ec2b40e and source archive SHA-256 is a6c3bbc1a65ce764d97c5beafe6ae693d8ed14c6cdae366b50e1974a79d4a00.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Issue/fix/release metadata only. Artifact chronology and hashes do not prove source inclusion or runtime behavior; the old issue is scoped to ezdxf 1.4.4 and is not a libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: Mutable issue index and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The index lists #1278, #1281, #1282, and #1283 as open. #1281 is repeated-token parser stack exhaustion; #1282 documents an APPID EED length wrapping a signed-short field at 32,768 bytes, with 32,764 as the reporter's positive control; #1283 is recursive object-model cloning via Insert(BlockRecord), distinct from DWG decoding. #1278's exact sequence was unavailable in the reviewed page. The detailed #1283 report was captured in the earlier plan section on peer issue mechanisms.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Version/API-specific issue reports and issue-index status; not local repros, format limits, or current peer release qualification.

sources.observed: The open issue horizon covers TEXT/MTEXT CR framing, block-body loss, DXF→DWG HATCH/ATTRIB/embedded-MTEXT handling, NOD selection, R2007+ string/codepage behavior, and CMC color-index behavior. The #1408 author reports a private real-file failure and was unable to construct a minimal public reproducer.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Issue reports/status only; not a test of current master or evidence of analogous libdxfrw defects.

assessment.planImpact: Adds artifact/source binding to the existing optional ezdxf check, corrects the stale #1283 title-only summary by linking the already-captured detailed report, and reaffirms that peer parser, writer, model-copy, carrier, and native-acceptance failures remain separate. It adds no feature work or validation cost to individual slices.

implementationReadyChecks: At the existing composed peer checkpoint only, record peer artifact SHA-256, source/tag/commit, runtime, optional features, OS, operation/direction, format versions, source/output hashes, and diagnostics.
Before using ezdxf 1.4.5 as current Binary-DXF proxy evidence, verify that the pinned artifact contains merged commit c87c87e and run the generated ASCII/Binary proxy-byte control with strict reopen.
Keep ACadSharp #1283 classified as API/model-copy complexity; do not infer parser or DWG byte-layout work from it.
Reuse existing local repeated-record, EED boundary, block/owner closure, proxy-byte, and strict-publication controls; do not copy peer thresholds or add duplicate stress tests.
Keep external/customer drawings and unavailable private issue attachments out of repository fixtures.
